CheckRules.description_en: Checks data protection scoring rules. Calling this operation triggers an asynchronous task to check whether your resources meet the requirements of data protection scoring
CheckRules.description_zh: 检查数据保护评分规则。调用该接口将会触发一个异步任务来检查您的资源是否满足数据保护评分的要求

CloseBdrcService.description_en: Shuts down the Backup and Disaster Recovery Center

DescribeCheckDetails.description_en: Queries the check results of data protection rules
DescribeCheckDetails.description_zh: 查询数据保护规则检查结果

DescribeProductDataRedundancyTypeStat.description_en: Queries statistics information on data redundancy types for cloud services
DescribeProductDataRedundancyTypeStat.description_zh: 查询云产品数据冗余类型统计信息

DescribeProducts.description_en: Queries the data protection score status of cloud services
DescribeProducts.description_zh: 查询云产品的数据保护评分状态

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the list of regions. BDRC is a centralized service. This operation is used for features that are related to specific regions
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询地域列表。BDRC本身是中心化的产品，接口用于部分与Region相关的功能使用

DescribeRules.description_en: Queries a list of data protection rules
DescribeRules.description_zh: 查询数据保护规则列表

DescribeTask.description_en: Queries the details of an asynchronous task

DescribeTasks.description_en: Queries the list of asynchronous tasks

DescribeTopRiskyResources.description_en: Queries the list of resources with the most risks
DescribeTopRiskyResources.description_zh: 查询风险最多的资源列表

DisableCheckProduct.description_en: Disables the data protection scoring for a cloud service
DisableCheckProduct.description_zh: 关闭云产品的数据保护评分

DisableCheckResource.description_en: Disables the data protection scoring for a resource
DisableCheckResource.description_zh: 关闭资源的数据保护评分

EnableCheckProduct.description_en: Enables the data protection scoring for an Alibaba Cloud service
EnableCheckProduct.description_zh: 开启云产品的数据保护评分

EnableCheckResource.description_en: Enables the data protection score for a single resource
EnableCheckResource.description_zh: 开启单个资源的数据保护评分

EnableCrossAccountManagement.description_en: Enables cross-account management. Only a BDRC delegated administrator can call this operation. This operation starts the trusted service on the resource directory side
EnableCrossAccountManagement.description_zh: 开启跨账号管理，只有BDRC委派管理员能够调用，会启用资源目录侧的可信服务

GetBdrcService.description_en: Queries the status of the Data Disaster Recovery center
GetBdrcService.description_zh: 查询数据灾备中心状态

ListCrossAccounts.description_en: Queries the list of cross-account management relationships
ListCrossAccounts.description_zh: 查询跨账号纳管关系列表

ListProtectionPolicies.description_en: Retrieves a list of protection policies

ListProtectionPolicyApplications.description_en: Retrieves the application history of a protection policy
ListProtectionPolicyApplications.description_zh: 获取保护策略应用历史

ListResourceCategories.description_en: Retrieves the list of resource categories

OpenBdrcService.description_en: Enables the Backup and Disaster Recovery Center

UpdateCrossAccounts.description_en: Incrementally updates cross-account governance relationships. Only BDRC delegated administrators can call this operation
UpdateCrossAccounts.description_zh: 只有BDRC委派管理员能够调用，增量更新跨账号纳管关系

UpdateResources.description_en: Updates the resources. After you call this operation, an asynchronous task is triggered to update your resources and data protection score
UpdateResources.description_zh: 更新资源列表。调用该接口后，将会触发一个异步任务来更新您的资源列表和数据保护评分
